## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — task-6 flips this script to enforcing for dd-4.)

Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh — ripgrep scan across 4 zones (plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/, .github/workflows/*.yml, tests/, full-repo) for 5 module names (bootstrap, orphan_band, duplicates_band, stale_band, open_count_skew_band). Default advisory mode (exit 0); --strict flag (exit non-zero on hits). chmod +x; use mktemp /tmp/bridge-scan.XXXXXX.

## Test Approach
Given script in advisory mode with 5 legacy modules still present; When invoked without --strict; Then exits 0, prints per-zone summary, lists hits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lint: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh
- [ ] Script executable: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh
- [ ] Advisory mode exits 0 even with hits
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh; test $? -eq 0
- [ ] Reports per-zone counts
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_check_deleted_bridge_imports.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
